purpose: Explicitly documents the small set of numeric utilities that remain because they express geometry, resets, or browser positioning rather than spacing-ramp decisions.

ownership.adopted-snapshots: Numeric utilities inside files carrying @vrooliComponentSource react-component-library:* remain governed by the library release and are not local hand-rolled surfaces.
ownership.geometry: Icon boxes, touch-target fallbacks, zero-size flex constraints, skeleton dimensions, and absolute positioning are documented here until dedicated geometry tokens are introduced.
ownership.spacing: All newly authored layout spacing uses space-3xs through space-2xl or touch; this exception list does not authorize new spacing literals.
